rules.title: Name competing comparison baselines
rules.instruction: Name the compared quantity and baseline when more than one is plausible. Resolve them only from supplied text or evidence; otherwise ask the author.
rules.context: Results sentences containing several possible comparison baselines.
rules.rationale: The reader should not have to infer which estimate is compared.
